projects.title: Shefa: AI Front-Desk Agent for Hospitals
projects.description: An AI agent that answers hospital calls in Bangla and English, so patients no longer wait in a phone queue to book a doctor.
projects.longDescription: Hospital phone lines are busy from the first hour of the morning, and patients often hang up before a receptionist answers. Shefa is our in-house AI front-desk agent with one job: take the booking call. It picks up inbound calls, understands what the patient needs in Bangla or English, and checks the requested doctor's availability. It then offers the open slots, reserves the one the patient chooses, gives a serial number, and tells the patient the expected time of visit. Reception staff see every booking as it happens and can take over any call.

features.title: Call Handling
items: **24/7 Call Pickup**: Answers every inbound call immediately, so no patient waits in the queue.
**Bangla & English Conversations**: Understands the patient in either language, including mixed sentences.
**Human Takeover**: Reception can join or take over any call with the full transcript on screen.

features.title: Booking Engine
items: **Doctor & Department Lookup**: Matches the patient's need to the right doctor or department.
**Live Slot Availability**: Offers only slots that are open at that moment, so double bookings are avoided.
**Serial & Visit Time**: Gives the patient a serial number and the expected time of visit, then sends a confirmation.

features.title: Hospital Operations
items: **Doctor Schedules**: Hospital admins update schedules and leave days in one place.
**Booking Dashboard**: Calls, bookings, and unanswered requests in real time.
**Audit Trail**: Every call summary and booking change is logged for review.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Patients describe symptoms and departments in everyday language
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Shefa maps everyday phrases to departments and doctors, and asks one clarifying question when the request is unclear.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Two callers must never be given the same slot
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Each slot is reserved against live availability at the moment of confirmation, not when the call started.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Staff must trust the agent before they rely on it
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Reception can monitor calls live, take over at any point, and review a summary of every conversation.

projects.title: Safar: Electric Neighborhood Shuttle for Dhaka
projects.description: An electric shuttle service with 25 fleets on fixed routes across Dhaka, with a commuter app that shows where the next shuttle is in real time.
projects.longDescription: Safar runs electric neighborhood shuttles on defined routes across Dhaka, giving commuters an affordable and comfortable ride for short and medium trips. Our commuter app shows every shuttle on a live map, like a ride-tracking app, so riders know exactly when and where to wait. Location sharing is limited to the shuttles and the commuters who are riding, and each route has its own stops. A current example is the route from Jashimuddin to Uttara North Metro Station.

features.title: Commuter App
items: **Live Shuttle Map**: See each shuttle on the route, its direction, and its estimated arrival at your stop.
**Seat Availability**: Check how many seats are free before you walk to the stop.
**Route Planning**: Choose your pickup and drop-off stops on a defined route.

features.title: Fleet Operations
items: **Fleet Monitoring**: Track all 25 electric shuttles from one control view.
**Route & Stop Management**: Add or adjust stops and timetables without an app update.
**Driver Check-in**: Shift start and stop are recorded for each shuttle.

features.title: Privacy & Safety
items: **Shared Location Only**: Location is shared only between a shuttle and the commuters riding it.
**Role-Based Access**: Operators, drivers, and commuters each see only what they need.
**Data Minimization**: Ride history is kept only as long as operations require.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Live positions must update smoothly on mobile networks
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Shuttle positions stream over a lightweight connection and the app falls back to the last known position when the signal drops.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Commuters need arrival times they can trust in heavy traffic
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Arrival estimates combine the shuttle's live position with recent travel times on the same stretch of road.

challengesAndSolutions.problem: Electric shuttles must be managed like a fleet
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Each shuttle has its own status, route, and shift record, so operators can reassign a vehicle in a few taps.

blogs.title: Why Every Business Needs an AI Voice Agent Now
blogs.excerpt: Missed calls are lost revenue. Here is how AI voice agents answer every call, book appointments, and hand off the hard cases to your team.
blogs.content:
Every missed call is a potential customer who calls a competitor. For clinics, hotels, real estate firms, logistics companies, and service businesses, the phone is still the most important sales and support channel, and it is often unanswered after office hours or during busy periods.

An AI voice agent answers that call immediately. It understands natural speech in Bangla, English, and the mixed language many customers use, checks availability in your calendar, books or reschedules appointments, answers common questions about services and prices, and sends a confirmation message when the call ends.

## What a good voice agent does

A useful voice agent does three things well. It answers routine questions instantly, so staff are not interrupted. It completes simple tasks end to end, such as booking a slot or taking a message. And it knows when to stop: when a caller is upset, asks for a manager, or describes something urgent, the call is transferred to a person with a short summary of what was said.

## How to start

Begin with one call type, such as appointment booking or after-hours enquiries. Write down the ten questions your team hears most often and the answers you want given. Connect the agent to the calendar or booking system you already use. Then test it with real examples from your customers before it goes live.

Measure what matters: answer rate, bookings made, average handling time, and the number of calls handed to staff. Review a sample of recordings every week during the first month and refine the scripts and rules.

## The bottom line

Voice AI is not about replacing your team. It is about making sure no caller is ignored, that routine work does not crowd out important work, and that every conversation is recorded and searchable. At Auravine we design these systems around your business rules, deploy them securely, and keep improving them after launch.

blogs.title: Chatbots That Cite Their Sources: Building Trust with Customers
blogs.excerpt: A chatbot that guesses damages your brand. Retrieval-based answers with citations keep your customer conversations accurate.
blogs.content:
Customers ask the same questions every day: What is the price? How long does delivery take? What is your return policy? Can I change my booking? A chatbot can answer these questions around the clock, but only if its answers are accurate. A chatbot that guesses damages trust faster than having no chatbot at all.

The difference is how the answers are produced. Many simple bots rely on fixed scripts that break when a question is phrased differently. Generative models write fluent answers, but they can invent details. The approach we use for business chatbots is retrieval-based: the assistant first searches your own documents, such as product catalogs, policies, and price lists, and then writes its answer using only that material.

## Citations build confidence

Each answer links to the page or document it came from. Customers can check the policy themselves, and your staff can see exactly what the bot relied on. When the documents do not contain an answer, the bot says so and offers a handoff to a person rather than making something up.

## One knowledge base, every channel

The same knowledge should power your website chat, WhatsApp, and Messenger. When the information changes, you update it once. Conversations stay in one inbox, so an agent who takes over a chat sees the full history instead of asking the customer to repeat themselves.

## Measure and improve

Track three numbers from day one: the share of questions answered without a handoff, the questions the bot could not answer, and customer satisfaction after each conversation. The unanswered questions are your roadmap. Add the missing information, and the assistant gets better without a rebuild.
